1	# Design Workspace - notes
2	
3	A redesign of Prelude's design page (`/f/:folder/d/:design`, its sessions and
4	the pop-out window): today `server/views/_session.eta`, `_design.eta`,
5	`_branch.eta`, `_entry.eta`, `_status.eta`, `_composer.eta`, `_window.eta`.
6	It renders in the shell's `workspace` and `window` layouts. The routes carry
7	`"from": "@app/server/views/…"`, so the build ports it back.
8	
9	Pages: Design page, with drawers (About the design, Rules, Open
10	questions) and modals (an image, Mark up, Turn on dictation); Pop-out
11	window. The fake project is a lender's borrower portal, so sizes (phone,
12	tablet) and a second client (its mobile app) mean something. States:
13	typical, pages differ, doesn't render, agent working, new design, update
14	clashed, popped out, new session; and for visuals in the chat: a flow and
15	a map, several visuals, a visual not drawn, visuals popped out, drawing a
16	visual (streaming), ask and fix (a fix's conversation, its own design).
17	
18	All seven items of the first review are now designed or settled (item 4,
19	the record picker, was dropped).
20	
21	## Decisions
22	
23	- **Scope: 1-3 of the review, plus the pop-out** (the person, 2026-10-17):
24	  the header, the design bar, and check results that lead somewhere.
25	- **A one-line header.** Crumbs and title, then the branch as one button
26	  with pills for what to act on (check, behind main, a clash). It opens a
27	  drawer (`/about`) with the branch in full and its actions, what the design
28	  uses, and what the agent can read. An update that clashed also shows as a
29	  notice above the work, since it holds the branch.
30	- **The chat owns its toolbar**: sessions menu, Show Agent/Tools.
31	- **The design page is for designing only** (the person, 2026-10-20): every
32	  build session opens in Build (`prelude/build`), so the design page has no
33	  Design | App switch or App mode, no "This session builds …" notice, no
34	  "Next:" entry, no Build pill or bui
